info.title: Thumble read API
info.description: Public discovery and authenticated account-read subset for Thumble phone gamepad controllers. Generation and writes are disabled on the hosted agent integration. Native device management is outside this contract. REST URL major versioning and deprecation policy: https://thumble.io/api-policy. Free zero-auth synthetic sandbox: /v1/sandbox.

profile.description: Normalized usable-canvas coordinates; x+width and y+height must fit within 1. Read list_devices for logical canvas dimensions. Cloud validate_profile and save_profile require deviceId: targets must be at least 48 points on both axes, sticks at least 96 points in diameter, and touch areas must not overlap controls or the top Chat/menu areas. IDs must be unique. Each control needs exactly one mapping: button to one button, trigger to lt/rt, stick to [lx,ly] or [rx,ry]. Optional invertX/invertY booleans reverse stick output axes without changing thumb visuals. Analog outputs have one owner. Labels do not bind WoW spells. No executable code, macros, timers or generated input.
